Subject: Service provider designation & evidence for CCPA/USPA compliance

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our legal team is preparing a short privacy addendum (US state privacy/CCPA scope) and needs to confirm Redwood's position re: service provider/processor designation and supporting evidence. Specifically they asked for: 

- A written statement confirming Redwood will act as a "service provider" (limited use) under CCPA/CPRA/US state privacy laws for AcmeCorp data.
- A current list of subprocessors with locations and (for cloud vendors) the contractual flow-down status (i.e., whether they are engaged as subprocessors with equivalent contract terms).
- Any audit/evidence documents you can share (SOC/attestation links, or a short memo describing controls aligned to limited use).

Can you send over a short package we can attach to our vendor risk intake? We need this by end of week if possible.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Lee
Head of Data Privacy Operations
AcmeCorp

Sam — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide what you need. I'm looping in Monica from Legal Ops and Priyom from Privacy to coordinate the package.

Quick plan: 
1) We will provide a short confirmation letter stating Redwood acts as a "service provider" under CCPA/CPRA with the limited-use commitments (no selling, only authorized processing, assist with requests).
2) We'll attach a redacted subprocessor register and note locations and contract flow-down status.
3) We'll include links to our SOC 2 report and a one-page controls memo focused on data residency, access controls, and limited-use enforcement.

I'll attach a draft SP addendum (for evidence not signature) and a redline for your legal team to review. Monica/Priyom — can you confirm the latest subprocessor CSV and whether we can share the SOC link publicly or need NDAs?

Vivek

Vivek — copying status:

- Subprocessor list: attached redacted_subprocessor_list.csv. Columns: vendor, service, primary location, contract_flowdown (yes/no), notes. We redact vendor-specific IP fields but include location and flowdown flag.
- SOC 2: we host the SOC 2 report behind a gated link. For vendor risk teams we provide a temporary viewer link after an NDA. For most enterprise customers we also supply a controls memo (1-2 pages) summarizing: data segregation, access reviews, KMS usage, limited-use enforcement, and logging/audit capabilities.
- Draft confirmation letter: attached as Acme_SP_Annex_v1.pdf (statement of limited use + brief exec summary). I included a redline version for negotiation (redline_SP_Annex_v1.docx).

Thanks Monica/Vivek — this is really helpful. A couple quick follow-ups from legal: 

1) On the confirmation letter, they want explicit language on "no further sale or commercial use" and that Redwood will not retain, use, or disclose Personal Information outside of service delivery purposes. Could you add that in the final wording?
2) For subprocessors listed as "contract_flowdown=no", we need to understand why (e.g., vendor is a reseller vs. a pure subprocessor) and whether there are alternate contractual protections. A one-line explanation in the CSV for those rows will suffice.
3) Regarding SOC 2, we can execute Acme's standard mutual NDA for the viewer link. Is Monica able to send the link gated to legal.ops@acmecorp.com after NDA?

If you can get the updated letter + annotated CSV and either the SOC link or the controls memo by end of day Friday we should be able to clear the intake. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sam
